input.content:
Biogas plant BGA8 digests maize silage, grass silage and cattle slurry. A solid feeder with a 40 cubic metre hopper and a hydraulic push-floor charges the solid substrate directly into digester F1; a slurry pre-pit (4×6 m, approx. 40 cubic metres) pumps the cattle slurry into F1 as well.

Digester F1 has a diameter of 20 m and a wall height of 6 m and is equipped with two paddle agitators and one submersible agitator. It carries a dome roof; the gas space (including headspace) is 385 cubic metres. It is operated mesophilically at 41 degrees Celsius (314.15 K) with a fill level of 90 percent. The digestate flows from F1 into post-digester N1 and from there on into post-digester N2. Both post-digesters are structurally identical: 24 m diameter, 6 m wall height, one long-axis agitator and one submersible agitator each, dome roof with a gas space (including headspace) of 610 cubic metres each, heated to 41 degrees Celsius, fill level 90 percent. From N2 the digestate passes into digestate store G1 with 26 m diameter, 6 m wall height, two submersible agitators and a gas space (including headspace) of 719 cubic metres; the store is unheated (approx. 20 degrees Celsius / 293.15 K), fill level 90 percent.

The biogas of all four tanks is fed through a gas collecting pipe to a CHP unit with a rated electrical output of 300 kW (electrical efficiency 40 percent, thermal efficiency 45 percent). Air is blown into the gas space of N1 for desulphurisation. An emergency flare rated 300 cubic metres per hour and a condensate shaft are present.

Substrate feed: 12 t/d maize silage and 3 t/d grass silage through the solid feeder into F1 plus 12 cubic metres per day of cattle slurry from the pre-pit into F1.

T_ad.rationale: mesophil bei 41 C — der 40-C-Default liegt ausserhalb des Bandes

V_gas.note: Kuppeldach plus Kopfraum; hier wird auch die Luft zur biologischen Entschwefelung eingeblasen

components.note: baugleich zu N1 und dahinter in Reihe geschaltet — zwei Nachgaerer hintereinander gibt es sonst in keiner Anlage des Datensatzes
